tools.name: options_pnl_at_expiry
tools.description: Exact P/L at expiry for a position of up to 8 legs (calls, puts, shares, long or short): net premium (debit or credit), breakevens, highest and lowest P/L at expiry (or Unlimited), and the P/L at each strike and at any underlying prices given. Covers spreads, straddles, strangles, iron condors, butt

tools.name: options_pnl_before_expiry
tools.description: Black-Scholes model estimate of a position's P/L a given number of days from now at a given underlying price, for up to 8 legs. Each option leg needs its days to expiry and volatility. The interest rate and dividend yield must be supplied; nothing is built in.

tools.name: black_scholes
tools.description: Black-Scholes model value of one European-style call or put per share and per 100-share contract, with delta, gamma, theta per calendar day, vega per volatility point and rho per rate point. All inputs, including the interest rate and dividend yield, must be supplied.

tools.name: implied_volatility
tools.description: The Black-Scholes volatility at which the model value equals a given option price, or a message when no volatility fits that price. All inputs, including the interest rate and dividend yield, must be supplied.

tools.name: covered_call
tools.description: For 100 shares per contract with one call written against them: net debit, breakeven at expiry, return if called and if not called (each with its per-year figures), highest and lowest P/L at expiry.

tools.name: cash_secured_put
tools.description: For a put written with cash set aside to take 100 shares per contract at the strike: cash secured, breakeven and cost per share if assigned, return on the cash with its per-year figures, highest and lowest P/L at expiry.

tools.name: covered_call_roll
tools.description: Closing a written call and writing a new one: net credit or debit of the roll, total premium kept, new breakeven, return if called at the new strike with its per-year figures, highest and lowest P/L at the new expiry.

tools.name: annualized_return
tools.description: Turns a return over a number of calendar days into per-year figures, simple and compounded, shown beside the period return.
